# Mullai Venese — Full Portfolio Knowledge Base

## About Mullai Venese
Mullai Venese is a Front-End Developer and UI/UX Designer dedicated to building high-performance, aesthetically refined, and accessible digital products. With deep expertise across design systems, modern web engineering, and brand identity, Mullai bridges the gap between vision and pixel-perfect execution.
